'''Shakshuka''' is a popular Middle Eastern dish with many variations. It is vegetarian-friendly.

==Ingredients==
* 1 whole yellow [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|oil]]
* 4–5 plum [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|Bell pepper]] (red or green)
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Basil|basil]] or black [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|Cayenne pepper]], [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]], and [[Cookbook:Turmeric|turmeric]] to taste

==Equipment==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cutting Board|cutting board]]
* 1 kitchen [[Cookbook:Knife|knife]]

==Procedure==
# Peel and [[Cookbook:Chop|chop]] the onion. [[Cookbook:Fry|Fry]] it in the oil until it turns translucent.
# Chop the tomatoes and pepper, and add to the onion in the pan.
# Add herbs and spices. Cover and let cook until the tomatoes are evenly cooked through (around 25 minutes on low heat).
# With a wooden spoon, make two holes in the onion-tomato mix.
# Break and pour each egg into its own hole. Cover and let cook until the eggs are firm (around 5 more minutes).
# Serve with bread.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
Variations can include:
* Tuna and garlic
* Cheese on top
* Bread inside
